title: Industry Collaboration on Safety Automation
answer: TransCelerate BioPharma, an alliance of drugmakers, runs an initiative on intelligent automation in pharmacovigilance that surveys member companies and publishes practical tools covering AI, robotic process automation and natural language processing across safety processes.

reading.body:
TransCelerate, an alliance of drugmakers, runs a pharmacovigilance automation initiative that surveys its members and publishes shared tools covering AI, robotic process automation and natural language processing.

The pattern is pre-competitive collaboration on the unglamorous layer of safety work. Rather than each company validating its own automation in isolation, members pool survey findings and practical tools across safety processes. That matters for AI because validation is the slow step in deploying models in regulated work, and a framework several sponsors already accept is easier to defend to an inspector than one built alone.

The practical instruction is to reuse these frameworks rather than invent your own. The data covers the initiative's existence, its survey method, and the three technology categories it addresses. It does not give adoption numbers, named member companies, specific tools, or any regulatory decision, so it cannot tell you how far automation has actually spread or what any regulator has accepted.

sections.body: Shared industry frameworks make validation arguments easier with inspectors; reuse them rather than inventing your own.
